common.phone_id_hint: Give this ID to HR so they can approve this phone.

company.title: Your company
company.intro: Type the code your HR gave you, or scan the QR code on the poster.
company.invalid: Company codes are 3 to 30 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes, starting with a letter.
company.not_found: We can't find that company code. Check it with HR.
company.provisioning: This company is still being set up. Try again in a few minutes.
company.suspended: This company's TapIn360 account is suspended. Ask HR.
company.unavailable: This company can't use TapIn360 right now. Ask HR.
company.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
company.unreachable: Can't reach TapIn360. Check your internet connection and try again.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.hint: Point the camera at the TapIn360 poster from HR.
scan.not_tapin: This QR code is not a TapIn360 company code.
scan.camera_denied: Camera access is needed to scan the QR code. Allow it in Settings.

setup.title: Custom server
setup.intro: For on-premise or other attendance servers. Enter the address from your IT team.
setup.url_invalid: Enter a valid http:// or https:// address.
setup.not_server: This address answers, but it is not a TapIn360 attendance server (HTTP {status}).
setup.redirect: The server redirects to {location}. Use that address instead.
setup.unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
setup.change_warning: Changing the server logs you out.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Use the Badge ID and PIN from HR.
login.expired: Your session ended. Log in again.
login.unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
login.blocked_title: This phone is not registered for you
login.blocked_body: Ask HR to approve it. Give them this phone's ID:

home.no_taps_yet: No taps on this phone yet
home.hold_card: Hold your phone to the card
home.hold_detail: Touch the back of the phone to the TapIn360 card at the entrance.
home.hold_detail_photo: Touch the back of the phone to the TapIn360 card at the entrance. The camera opens next.
home.ios_detail: Press Scan card, then hold the top of your iPhone to the TapIn360 card.
home.ios_detail_photo: Press Scan card, then hold the top of your iPhone to the TapIn360 card. The camera opens next.
home.manual_detail: Choose one, then hold your phone to the card.
home.selected_in: Check in: hold your phone to the card
home.selected_out: Check out: hold your phone to the card
home.need_action: Choose Check in or Check out first
home.ios_sheet: Hold the top of your iPhone near the card
home.unreadable_card: This card has no readable ID

banner.location_denied: Location is needed to record attendance.
banner.location_service_off: Location is off. Turn it on to record attendance.
banner.nfc_off: NFC is off. Turn it on to tap the card.
banner.nfc_unsupported: This phone has no NFC. Use another phone.
banner.switched_off: Your access is switched off. Contact your HR.
banner.location_approximate: Allow precise location: approximate location can't confirm you are at the site.

result.saved_body: Your tap at {time} is saved and will be sent automatically.
result.no_gps: No GPS signal. Move near a window and tap again.
result.row_waiting: Waiting to send · shown in History

reason.too_soon: Too soon after your last tap

photo.title: Look at the screen
photo.whole_face: Show your whole face in the frame
photo.check_failed: Could not check the photo — try again
photo.camera_denied: Camera access is needed for the attendance photo. Allow it in Settings.
photo.no_camera: This phone has no front camera.

history.title: History
history.discarded: Not sent: another employee logged in on this phone
history.undeliverable: Not sent: the server kept answering with an error for over a day. Tell HR.

logout.confirm_body: You will need your Employee ID and PIN to log in again.
logout.discard_body: These taps have not reached the server yet. They are deleted if you continue.
